questions.prompt: What information can the lspci command display about the system hardware? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Al ejecutar lspci (especialmente con -v o -vv ), muestra los dispositivos conectados al bus PCI junto con el fabricante/vendedor ( vendor ID ), los recursos de hardware asignados como las interrupciones ( IRQ ) y la velocidad de enlace del bus PCI. No muestra direcciones MAC de capa de enlace (eso lo muestra ip link ) ni información de la batería (ACPI).

questions.prompt: A backup software heavily uses hard links between files which have not been changed in between two backup runs. Which benefits are realized due to these hard links? (Choose two.)

options.text: The old backups can be moved to slow backup media, such as tapes, while still serving as hard link target in new backups.
The backup r uns faster because hard links are asynchronous operations, postponing the copy operation to a later po int in time.
The backup is guaranteed to be uncharged because a hard linked file cannot be modified after its creation.
The b ackup consumes less space because the hard links point to the same data o n disk instead of storing redundan t copies.
The backup runs faster because, instead of copying the data of each file, hard links only change file syst em metadata.

questions.explanation: Al crear enlaces duros para archivos no modificados (técnica habitual en herramientas como rsync --link-dest ), no se duplican los bloques de datos en disco, ahorrando espacio, y la operación es casi instantánea porque solo añade una entrada de directorio e incrementa el contador de enlaces en el inodo (metadatos).

options.text: NetworkManager reconfigures all network interfaces to use DHCP unless they are specifically managed by NetworkManager.
NetworkManager must be explicitly enabled for each interface it should manage.
NetworkManager by default does not change interfaces which are already configured.
NetworkManager disables all interfaces which were not configured by NetworkManager.
NetworkManager can be configured to use the distribution's network interface configuration.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Linux filesystems preallocate a fixed number of inodes when creating a new filesystem instead of generating them as needed? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Los sistemas de archivos de la familia Extended ( ext2 , ext3 , ext4 ) crean una tabla estática de inodos durante el formateo ( mkfs ), por lo que el número máximo de inodos queda fijado al crear el sistema de archivos (a diferencia de XFS, JFS o Btrfs, que asignan inodos de forma dinámica).

questions.prompt: What can the Logical Volume Manager (LVM) be used for? (Choose three.)

options.text: To dynamically change the size of logical volumes.
To dynamically create or delete logical volumes.

questions.explanation: LVM permite crear, redimensionar y eliminar volúmenes lógicos en caliente, así como tomar instantáneas ( snapshots ) del estado de un volumen. No existe un nivel "RAID 9", y el cifrado de bloques en Linux lo realiza LUKS/ dm-crypt , no LVM por sí mismo.

A dedicated system service, systemd-cron, handles the execution of timer units.
Timer units only exist in the system scope and are not available for users.
Each systemd timer unit controls a specific systemd service unit.

questions.prompt: Running chmod 640 filea.txt as a regular user doesn't update filea.txt's permission. What might be a reason why chmod cannot modify the permissions? (Choose two.)

options.text: filea.txt is owned by another user and a regular user cannot change the permissions of another user's file.
filea.txt is a symbolic link whose permissions are a fixed value which cannot be charged.
f ilea.txt has the sticky bit set and a regular user cannot remove this permission.
filea.txt is a hard link whose permissions are inherited from the target and cannot be set directly.
filea.txt has the SetUID bit set which imposes the restriction that only the root user can make changes to the f ile.

questions.explanation: Solo el propietario del archivo o el usuario root pueden cambiar los permisos de un archivo. Además, los enlaces simbólicos tienen siempre permisos ficticios ( lrwxrwxrwx ) que no pueden modificarse ( chmod actúa sobre el archivo destino, o si este no es propiedad del usuario o está roto, los permisos del enlace en sí nunca cambian).

questions.prompt: What is the process ID number of the init process on a System V init based system?

options.text: It is set to the current run level

questions.explanation: El proceso init es el primer proceso de espacio de usuario ejecutado por el kernel tras el arranque y el padre directo o indirecto de todos los demás procesos; el kernel le asigna siempre el PID 1 ( man 8 init ).

questions.prompt: Which mechanism does ssh use to interact with the SSH agent?

Creating an alias replacing ssh with calls to ssh-agent.
Starting ssh-agent as a child process for each ssh invo cation.
Evaluating environment variables such as SSH_AUTH_SOCK.

questions.prompt: In the vi editor, how can commands such as moving the cursor or copying lines into the buffer be issued multiple times or applied to multiple rows?

options.text: By using the command :repeat followed by the number and the command.
By specifying the number right in front of a command such as 41 or 2yj.
By selecting all affected lines using the shit and cursor keys before applying the command.
By is suing a command such as :set repetition=4 with repeats every subsequent command 4 times.
By specifying the number after a command such as 14 or yj2 followed by escape.

questions.explanation: En vi , cualquier comando de movimiento o edición en modonormal puede repetirse N N N veces escribiendo el número justo delante del comando (por ejemplo, 4l para avanzar 4 caracteres o 2yj para copiar la línea actual y las siguientes hacia abajo).

questions.prompt: What are the main differences between GPT and MBR partition tables regarding maximum number and size of partitions? (Choose two.)

options.text: M BR can handle partition sizes up to 4 TB, whereas GPT supports partition sizes up to 128 ZB.
By default, GPT can manage up to 128 partitions while MBR only supports four primary partitions.
By default, GPT can manage up to 64 partitions while MBR only supports 16 primary partitions.
MBR can handle partition sizes u p to 2.2 TB, whereas GPT supports sizes up to 9.4 ZB.
Both GPT and MBR support up to four primary partitio ns, each with up to 4096 TB.

questions.explanation: MBR utiliza direcciones de bloque de 32 bits (con sectores de 512 bytes tiene un límite de 2 32 × 512  bytes ≈ 2.2  TB 2^{32} \times 512 \text{ bytes} \approx 2.2 \text{ TB} 2 32 × 512  bytes ≈ 2.2  TB ) y su estructura solo permite 4 particiones primarias. GPT utiliza direcciones de 64 bits (soportando hasta 2 64 × 512  bytes ≈ 9.4  ZB 2^{64} \times 512 \text{ bytes} \approx 9.4 \text{ ZB} 2 64 × 512  bytes ≈ 9.4  ZB ) y reserva espacio por defecto para 128 particiones sin necesidad de particiones extendidas.

questions.prompt: What is true about the Hop Limit field in the IPv6 header?

options.text: The field is not changed during the transport of a package.
The field is transmitted within a hop-by-hop extension header.
Each router forwarding the packet increases the field's value.
Each router forwarding the packet decreases the field's value.
For multicast packages, the field's value is alwa ys 1.

questions.prompt: What is true about the file /etc/localtime?

options.text: It is a plain text file containing a string such as Europe/Berlin.
It is created and maintained by the NTP service based on the location of the system's IP address.
It is a symlink to /sys/device/clock/ltime and always contains the current local time.
After changing this fil e, newtzconfig has to be run to make the changes effective.
It is either a symlink to or a copy of a tim ezone information f ile such as /usr/share/zoneinfo/Europe/Berlin.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 107 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which command is used to set the hostname of the local system? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
correct: hostname (también válido en entornos modernos: hostnamectl )
acceptedAnswers: hostname (también válido en entornos modernos: hostnamectl )
questions.explanation: El comando clásico estándar en Linux para consultar o definir el nombre del sistema en tiempo de ejecución es hostname . En los exámenes de LPI donde se pide "solo el comando sin parámetros" para fijar el nombre de host, la respuesta primaria esperada es hostname (junto con hostnamectl en systemd ).

questions.prompt: Instead of supplying an explicit device in /etc/fstab for mounting, what other options may be used to identify the intended partition? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Según man 5 fstab , el primer campo puede identificar el dispositivo de bloques mediante su ruta ( /dev/sda1 ), su etiqueta de sistema de archivos ( LABEL= ) o su identificador único universal ( UUID= ).

questions.prompt: What information is provided by the echo $$ command?

options.text: The process ID of the current shell.
The process ID for the following command.
The process ID of the last command executed.
The process ID of the last command which has been placed in the background.
The process ID of the echo command.

questions.prompt: Which of the following signals is sent to a process when the key combination Ctrl+c is pressed on the keyboard?
questions.explanation: Según man 7 signal , al presionar la combinación de teclas de interrupción Ctrl+C en la terminal, el controlador de la terminal envía la señal SIGINT ( Interrupt from keyboard , señal número 2) al proceso que se encuentra en primer plano.

questions.prompt: How do shadow passwords improve the password security in comparison to standard no-shadow password?

options.text: Regular users do not have access to the password hashes of shadow passwords.
Every shadow password is valid for 45 days and must be changed afterwards.
The system's host key is used to encrypt all shadow passwords.
Shadow passwords are always combined with a public key that has to match the user's p rivate key.
Shadow passwords are stored in plain text and can be checked for weak passwords.

questions.explanation: Explicación oficial para la pregunta del Tema 110 evaluada en el examen de certificación LPIC-1.

questions.prompt: Which command is used to sync the hardware clock to the system clock? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
questions.explanation: El comando hwclock permite leer el reloj de hardware (RTC/BIOS) y sincronizarlo desde el reloj del sistema ( hwclock --systohc / -w ) o viceversa ( hwclock --hctosys / -s ).

questions.prompt: What information is shown by the echo $? command?

options.text: The process ID of the echo command.
The exit value of the command executed immediately before echo.
The process ID which will be used for the next command.

questions.prompt: The X11 configuration file xorg.conf is grouped into section. How is the content of the section SectionName represented?

options.text: It is placed in curly brackets as in Section SectionName {…}.
It is placed between the tags <Section " name=""SectionName"> and </Section> .
It is placed between a line containing Section "SectionName" and a line containing EndSect ion.
It is placed af ter the row [SectionName].
It is placed after an initial unindented Section "SectionName" and must be indented by exactly one tab character.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the xargs command?

options.text: It passes arguments to an X server.
It repeats the execution of a command using different parameters for each invocation.
It reads standard input and builds up commands to execute.
It asks a question, graphically, and returns the answer to the shell.
It allows specifying long options (like --help) for commands that normally only accept short options (like -h).

questions.explanation: Según man 1 xargs , xargs lee elementos desde la entrada estándar (delimitados por espacios, saltos de línea onulos) y construye y ejecuta líneas de comandos pasándoles dichos elementos como argumentos.

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands loads a kernel module along with any required dependency modules?
questions.explanation: A diferencia de insmod (que carga únicamente el archivo .ko indicado y falla si faltan dependencias), modprobe ( man 8 modprobe ) consulta modules.dep y carga de forma inteligente el módulo solicitado junto con todos los módulos de los que depende.

questions.prompt: Which file, if present, must contain all users that are allowed to use the cron scheduling system? (Specify the full name of the file, including path.).
questions.explanation: Si el archivo /etc/cron.allow existe en el sistema, solo los usuarios listados explícitamente dentro de él tienen permiso para usar crontab (ignorando /etc/cron.deny ).

questions.prompt: Which command included in systemd supports selecting messages from the systemd journal by criteria such as time or unit name? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
questions.explanation: journalctl es la utilidad cliente de systemd para consultar el registro binario de systemd-journald , permitiendo filtrar por unidades ( -u ), rangos de tiempo ( --since , --until ), prioridades ( -p ), etc.

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands lists the dependencies of the RPM package file foo.rpm?
questions.explanation: En rpm ( man 8 rpm ), -q inicia una consulta ( query ), -p indica que la consulta se realiza sobre un archivo de paquete .rpm (no instalado en la base de datos local) y -R ( --requires ) lista los paquetes o capacidades de los que depende.

questions.prompt: Which environment variable is used by an X11 client to determine the X Server to connect to? (Specify only the variable name without any preceding commands or values.).
questions.explanation: Cualquier cliente gráfico X11 consulta la variable de entorno DISPLAY para saber a qué servidor X, pantalla y monitor debe conectarse.
